name: feature-with-quote
title: Feature with quote
description: One feature explained on one side and the customer who proves it on the other: description, points and a quote card with the result.
docs: Pass feature (an eyebrow, a title, a description, three points, an href and the link's text) and quote (the words, the name, the role, the company, the address of a picture and the result). The words are a blockquote with the person in its caption: their picture (their initials until it loads, or when there is none), name, job and company. The result is one bold line on a band under the quote, outside it, so it reads as a fact the customer measured and not as something they said; leave it out for a quote without a number. On a phone the feature comes first; reverse swaps the sides from 768px of width. The card sets its padding and type from its own width, so it holds in a narrow column. headingLevel sets the level of the title, and labels translates the word over the result and the button's default text.
